result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-formed. The carousel clipping at the right edge and the partially visible pizza card at the bottom are expected and not reported. One real defect: the 'Tokumaru Ramen' restaurant title renders with a broken last character. There are also a few minor styling and readability concerns.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is rendered as 'Tokumaru Rameı', with the final 'n' cut off or garbled. The title sits well inside the card with plenty of free space, so this is not a legitimate carousel clip. It looks like a text rendering, clipping or font glyph problem.
issues.suggestion: Check the text container width, padding and overflow, and the font glyph or letter-spacing rendering. Make sure the full name displays, and use ellipsis truncation only when the text genuinely overflows.

issues.description: The secondary grey text (delivery fees, '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') and the inactive tab labels are light grey on white/light backgrounds and have low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive tab colors to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).

issues.description: The time badges (e.g. '15–25 min') overlap the card image corner. On the first card the pill also overlaps the plate image, so it looks cramped. The heart icon on the dark card sits on a semi-transparent dark circle with limited contrast against the dark image.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent spacing for the badges and give the favorite button a more opaque or lighter background so it stands out.
